ex.cn: 他们是好主顾，付账从不耽搁。

senses.chn: 坚决斗争；全力以赴地斗争

ex.cn: 我将标示牌钉到了一棵树上。

ex.cn: 警方还没有抓到杀人凶手。

ex.cn: 我们一定要戳穿这个谎言。

ex.cn: 他在半决赛中获胜。

ex.cn: 她在第二跳中表现出色，赢了比赛。

ex.cn: 各方似乎都渴望将停火之事敲定。

ex.cn: 她说要来，但我无法让她敲定具体什么时候来。

senses.def: to fasten sth to a wall, post, etc. with a nail or nails
senses.chn: 用钉子将…固定到（墙上、柱子上等）

senses.chn: 用钉子封住，封死（门或窗）

senses.def: a place where you can pay to have your nails shaped, coloured and made more attractive

senses.chn: 令人焦躁不安的；令人紧张的

ex.en: a nail-biting finish
ex.cn: 令人担心的结局

ex.en: It's been a nail-biting couple of weeks waiting for my results.
ex.cn: 这几个星期等结果，弄得我坐立不安。

senses.def: a small stiff brush for cleaning your nails
a small tool for cutting the nails on your fingers and toes
certain or definite

ex.cn: 那个点球毫无疑问，裁判绝不应该拒绝判罚！

senses.def: (in betting) believed to be very likely to succeed

ex.cn: 胜算很大的赌局

senses.def: a small metal tool with a rough surface for shaping your nails
clear or coloured liquid that you paint on your nails to make them look attractive

ex.en: nail polish/varnish remover
ex.cn: 洗甲水

senses.def: small scissors that are usually curved, used for cutting the nails on your fingers and toes

ex.en: a pair of nail scissors
ex.cn: 一把指甲剪

ex.en: to be politically naive
ex.cn: 对政治一无所知

ex.en: I can't believe you were so naive as to trust him!
ex.cn: 真是难以相信你会幼稚到信任他！

ex.en: a naive question
ex.cn: 无知的问题

senses.def: innocent and simple

ex.cn: 他们对待生活的态度天真率直，令人耳目一新。

ex.cn: 他们发现他身体半裸，流着血，快不行了。

ex.cn: 无罩灯

ex.cn: 出鞘之剑

ex.cn: 老鼠出生时遍体无毛。

ex.en: a naked flame
ex.cn: 明火

senses.def: expressed strongly and not hidden
senses.chn: 直白的；露骨的；毫不掩饰的

ex.cn: 赤裸裸的攻击

ex.en: the naked truth
ex.cn: 明摆着的事实

ex.cn: 没有装饰的墙

ex.cn: 你叫什么名字？

ex.cn: 请问您叫什么名字？

ex.cn: 请将您的姓名和地址写在下面。

ex.en: Do you know the name of this flower?
ex.cn: 你知道这是什么花吗？

ex.cn: 风疹只是德国麻疹的另一个名称。

ex.cn: 结婚时你要改姓氏吗？

senses.def: a reputation that sb/sth has; the opinion that people have about sb/sth

ex.en: She first made her name as a writer of children's books.
ex.cn: 她最初是以儿童读物作家成名的。

ex.en: He's made quite a name for himself (= become famous).
ex.cn: 他闯出了名气。

ex.en: The college has a good name for languages.
ex.cn: 这所大学的语言教学颇有名气。

ex.cn: 这种行为使学生们背上骂名。

senses.chn: 有…名称的；以…著名的；有…名声的

ex.en: a big-name company
ex.cn: 著名公司

ex.cn: 名牌产品

ex.cn: 一些艺术界的头面人物参加了聚会。

ex.cn: 她点名要找你。

ex.cn: 校长能叫出所有学生的姓名。

ex.cn: 我只是听说过她的名字。

ex.cn: 名叫汤姆 · 里斯的年轻演员

senses.chn: 申请参加；替…报名（入学、参赛等）

ex.cn: 你报名参加这次问答比赛了吗？

ex.en: He took my place and got killed. It should have been me—that bullet had my name on it.
ex.cn: 他代替我，结果送了命。死的本该是我，那颗子弹是冲着我来的。

ex.en: Are you coming for dinner this evening? I've got a steak here with your name on it!
ex.cn: 今晚你来吃饭吗？我为你准备了一块牛排呢！

senses.chn: （表示实际存在但未得到正式认可）在只缺正式名分情况下

ex.en: He runs the company in all but name.
ex.cn: 他虽没有名分，却实际上在管理这家公司。

senses.chn: （尤用于疑问句，表示愤怒、惊奇或震惊）看在上帝的分上，到底，究竟

ex.cn: 那噪音究竟是怎么回事？

ex.en: Where in the name of Heaven have you been?
ex.cn: 你到底上哪儿去了？

senses.def: for sb; showing that sth officially belongs to sb

ex.en: We reserved two tickets in the name of Brown.
ex.cn: 我们用布朗的名字预订了两张票。

ex.en: The car is registered in my name.
ex.cn: 这辆车是用我的名字登记的。

ex.cn: 我依法逮捕你。

ex.cn: 以宗教名义进行的犯罪活动

ex.cn: 他只是名义上的政党领袖。

ex.cn: 要想生意兴旺，勤奋工作是关键。

senses.chn: 大名鼎鼎的人；重量级人物；影响巨大的事物

ex.en: Miyazaki is still a name to conjure with among anime fans.
ex.cn: 宫崎骏在日本动漫迷中仍是一个大名鼎鼎的名字。

senses.chn: 难记的名字；拗口的名字

ex.en: He comes from Tighnabruaich—now there's a name to conjure with!
ex.cn: 他来自 Tighnabruaich，这个名字真够拗口的！

senses.chn: 知道…的名称；记住…的称呼

ex.en: I recognize the tune but I can't put a name to it.
ex.cn: 这曲子我听过，但想不起叫什么了。

senses.def: to show a lack of respect when using sb's name
senses.chn: 滥用…的名义；亵渎…的名字

ex.en: Have you been taking my name in vain again?
ex.cn: 你又在对我说三道四了吧？

senses.def: to have or own sth
senses.chn: 拥有；获得；收归某人的名下

ex.en: an Olympic athlete with five gold medals to his name
ex.cn: 夺得五枚金牌的一名奥林匹克运动员

ex.en: She doesn't have a penny/cent to her name (= she is very poor).
ex.cn: 她身无分文。

an important person
to use insulting words about sb

senses.chn: 恶名难洗；名声一毁，万难挽回

senses.def: to mention famous people you know or have met in order to impress others
senses.chn: 提及自己认识或见过的名人以抬高身价

ex.cn: 我非常愿意公开表示支持这个运动。

ex.cn: 我的最大特点就是有耐心！

ex.cn: 他有个滑稽的名字叫欧文 · 欧文。

senses.def: what is important is what people or things are, not what they are called
senses.chn: 玫瑰不叫玫瑰，依然芳香如故；名称并不是重要的东西

ex.cn: 受害人的姓名仍未得知。

ex.cn: 你能说出美国所有的州名吗？

ex.cn: 她认出了袭击她的人。

ex.cn: 我看不到谁在讲话，但我能辨别出声音。

ex.cn: 她一看就知道有没有便宜可捡。

ex.cn: 她在讲话开始时提到所有帮助过她的人的名字。

used as a polite reply to an expression of thanks
senses.chn: （回答道谢的客套语）不用谢，哪儿的话

ex.en: 'Thanks very much for your help.' 'Not at all, it was a pleasure.'
ex.cn: “多谢你帮了忙。” “别客气，不用谢。”

senses.def: used to say that no amount of money would persuade you to do or to sell sth
senses.chn: 无论如何也不；给多少钱也不

ex.en: I wouldn't work for her again—not at any price!
ex.cn: 我再也不替她做事了，给多少钱也不做！

senses.def: a system of signs or symbols used to represent information, especially in mathematics, science and music
not at all; not the smallest amount
quite good; better than you expected

ex.en: 'How are you?' 'Not too bad.'
ex.cn: “你怎么样？” “还不错。”

ex.en: That wasn't bad for a first attempt.
ex.cn: 第一次尝试，还算不错。

senses.def: to show no surprise or embarrassment when sth unusual happens
senses.chn: 不动声色；面不改色；眼睛都不眨一下

ex.en: She didn't bat an eyelid when I told her my news.
ex.cn: 我把我最近的事告诉她时，她一点也不为所动。

not be able to do sth to save your life.lemma: not be able to do sth to save your life

senses.def: to be completely unable to do sth
senses.chn: 完全干不了某事；死也做不了某事

ex.en: He can't interview people to save his life.
ex.cn: 要他的命，他也采访不了人。

not be about to do sth.lemma: not be about to do sth

senses.def: to not be willing to do sth; to not intend to do sth

ex.en: I've never done any cooking and I'm not about to start now.
ex.cn: 我从来没有做过饭，也不想从现在开始做起来。

senses.def: to not understand sth, even after it has been explained to you
senses.chn: （解释之后）依然不懂，仍不明白

ex.en: I've read the instructions, but I'm still none the wiser.
ex.cn: 我看了用法说明，但仍然弄不明白。

senses.def: to not know or find out about sth bad that sb has done
senses.chn: 不知道，发现不了（某人做的坏事）

ex.en: If you put the money back, no one will be any the wiser.
ex.cn: 只要你把钱放回去，谁都不会察觉。

senses.def: used to say that you are not stupid enough to believe what sb is telling you
senses.chn: （表示自己并不傻，不会轻信别人的话）

ex.en: Oh yeah? I wasn't born yesterday, you know.
ex.cn: 是吗？我可不是三岁的小孩子，你知道的。

senses.def: used when you are commenting that time is passing and that you are growing older

not be in the business of doing sth.lemma: not be in the business of doing sth

senses.def: not to be intending to do sth (which it would be surprising for you to do)

ex.en: I'm not in the business of getting other people to do my work for me.
ex.cn: 我无意让别人替我工作。

not be supposed to do sth.lemma: not be supposed to do sth

senses.def: to not be allowed to do sth

ex.en: You're not supposed to walk on the grass.
ex.cn: 不准践踏草地。

senses.def: to be of poor quality; to not be very good

ex.en: His work isn't up to much.
ex.cn: 他的活儿做得不怎么样。

senses.def: to be naked
if you say sth won't break the bank, you mean that it won't cost a lot of money, or more than you can afford
not nearly; not at all

ex.en: It's not over yet—not by a long chalk.
ex.cn: 这事还没有了结，还差得远呢。

not by any stretch of the imagination.lemma: not by any stretch of the imagination

senses.def: used to say strongly that sth is not true, even if you try to imagine or believe it
senses.chn: 任凭怎么想也不；再怎么说也不

ex.en: She could not, by any stretch of the imagination, be called beautiful.
ex.cn: 再怎么说，她也称不上漂亮。

senses.def: a level on a scale, often marking quality or achievement

ex.en: The quality of the food here has dropped a notch recently.
ex.cn: 这里的饭菜质量最近下降了一级。

senses.def: a V-shape or a circle cut in an edge or a surface, sometimes used to keep a record of sth
senses.chn: （表面或边缘的）V 形刻痕，圆形切口

ex.en: For each day he spent on the island, he cut a new notch in his stick.
ex.cn: 他在岛上每过一天，就在手杖上刻一个新的记号。

ex.en: She tightened her belt an extra notch.
ex.cn: 她将腰带又束紧了一格。

senses.def: to achieve sth such as a win or a high score

ex.en: The team has notched up 20 goals already this season.
ex.cn: 这支球队本赛季已经攻进 20 个球。

senses.def: to make a small V-shaped cut in an edge or a surface
senses.chn: （在表面或边缘）刻 V 形痕，刻下切口

senses.def: to be unsuccessful; to have no successful result

ex.en: How sad that all his hard work should come to nothing.
ex.cn: 他的所有辛勤劳动竟全部付诸东流，太让人伤心了。

ex.en: Her plans didn't come to anything.
ex.cn: 她的计划全落空了。

senses.def: to not be important or successful
senses.chn: 不重要；无关紧要；不成功

senses.def: unfair; not honourable
senses.chn: 不公正；不光明正大；不光彩；见不得人

senses.def: to do no work

ex.en: She hasn't done a hand's turn all week.
ex.cn: 她闲了整整一星期。

senses.def: a short piece of writing to help you remember sth

ex.en: Please make a note of the dates.
ex.cn: 请记下日期。

ex.en: She made a mental note (= decided that she must remember) to ask Alan about it.
ex.cn: 她提醒自己要记住向艾伦问问这事。

senses.def: a short informal letter

ex.en: Just a quick note to say thank you for a wonderful evening.
ex.cn: 仅以此短笺感谢您安排的美好夜晚。

ex.en: She left a note for Ben on the kitchen table.
ex.cn: 她在厨房的餐桌上给本留了个便条。

ex.en: a suicide note
ex.cn: 绝命书

senses.def: a short comment on a word or passage in a book

ex.en: a new edition of 'Hamlet', with explanatory notes
ex.cn: 附注释的新版《哈姆雷特》

ex.en: See note 3, page 259.
ex.cn: 见第 259 页注释 3。

senses.def: information that you write down when sb is speaking, or when you are reading a book, etc.
senses.chn: （听讲或读书等时的）记录，笔记

ex.en: He sat taking notes of everything that was said.
ex.cn: 他坐在那儿记下了所说的每一件事。

ex.en: Can I borrow your lecture notes?
ex.cn: 我可以借你的课堂笔记看看吗？

ex.en: Patients' medical notes have gone missing.
ex.cn: 患者的病历丢失了。

senses.def: information about a performance, an actor's career, a piece of music, etc. printed in a special book or on a CD case, record cover, etc.
senses.chn: （有关演出、演员经历、音乐等的）图书资料，录音或唱片等封套介绍

ex.en: The sleeve notes include a short biography of the performers on this recording.
ex.cn: 封套上的介绍包括本唱片中的演奏者生平简介。

senses.def: a piece of paper money

ex.en: a £5 note
ex.cn: 一张面值为 5 英镑的纸币

ex.en: We only exchange notes and traveller's cheques.
ex.cn: 我们只兑换纸币和旅行支票。

senses.def: a single sound of a particular length and pitch (= how high or low a sound is), made by the voice or a musical instrument; the written or printed sign for a musical note

ex.en: He played the first few notes of the tune.
ex.cn: 他演奏了这支曲子开始的几个音。

ex.en: high/low notes
ex.cn: 高音；低音

senses.def: a particular quality in sth, for example in sb's voice or the atmosphere at an event

ex.en: There was a note of amusement in his voice.
ex.cn: 听他的口气，是觉得很有意思。

ex.en: On a more serious note (= speaking more seriously) …
ex.cn: 说点严肃的…

ex.en: On a slightly different note (= changing the subject slightly), let's talk about…
ex.cn: 咱们略微换一下话题，谈谈…

senses.def: an official document with a particular purpose

ex.en: a sick note from your doctor
ex.cn: 医生开具的病假证明

ex.en: The buyer has to sign a delivery note as proof of receipt.
ex.cn: 购买者必须签收送货单表明货已收到。

senses.def: an official letter from the representative of one government to another

ex.en: an exchange of diplomatic notes
ex.cn: 外交照会的互换

senses.def: of importance or of great interest

ex.en: a scientist of note
ex.cn: 著名的科学家

ex.en: The museum contains nothing of great note.
ex.cn: 这家博物馆没有什么很有价值的东西。

senses.def: to do, say or write sth that is suitable/not suitable for a particular occasion
senses.chn: 做（或说、写）得得体／不得体

senses.def: to express feelings or opinions of a particular kind

ex.en: She sounded a note of warning in her speech.
ex.cn: 她在讲话中透出了警告的意味。

senses.def: to pay attention to sth and be sure to remember it

ex.en: Take note of what he says.
ex.cn: 牢记他说的话。

senses.def: if two or more people compare notes, they each say what they think about the same event, situation, etc.
to notice or pay careful attention to sth

ex.en: Note the fine early Baroque altar inside the chapel.
ex.cn: 注意小教堂里精致的早期巴罗克风格的祭坛。

ex.en: Please note (that) the office will be closed on Monday.
ex.cn: 请注意办事处星期一将关闭。

ex.en: Note how these animals sometimes walk with their tails up in the air.
ex.cn: 注意观察这些动物如何有时翘起尾巴走路。

ex.en: It should be noted that dissertations submitted late will not be accepted.
ex.cn: 应该注意的是迟交的论文将不予接受。

ex.en: The first thing I noticed about the room was the smell.
ex.cn: 我首先注意到的是这屋子里的气味。

ex.en: Please note (that) the office will be closed on Monday.
ex.cn: 请注意办事处星期一将关闭。

senses.def: to mention sth because it is important or interesting

ex.en: It is worth noting that the most successful companies had the lowest prices.
ex.cn: 值得指出的是最成功的公司价格最低。

ex.en: He refused to comment until after the trial.
ex.cn: 他拒绝在审判前作任何评论。

ex.en: He noted in passing that the company's record on safety issues was not good.
ex.cn: 他顺便提到该公司在安全方面的记录不好。

ex.en: Critics remarked that the play was not original.
ex.cn: 评论家指出这部戏剧缺乏创意。

ex.en: She observed that it was getting late.
ex.cn: 她说天色晚了。

ex.en: Some critics argue that Picasso remained a great master all his life.
ex.cn: 一些评论家认为毕加索毕生都是一位大师。

senses.def: to write down sth important so that you will not forget it

example.en: Note the fine early Baroque altar inside the chapel.
example.cn: 注意小教堂里精致的早期巴罗克风格的祭坛。

example.en: Please note (that) the office will be closed on Monday.
example.cn: 请注意办事处星期一将关闭。

example.en: Note how these animals sometimes walk with their tails up in the air.
example.cn: 注意观察这些动物如何有时翘起尾巴走路。

example.en: It should be noted that dissertations submitted late will not be accepted.
example.cn: 应该注意的是迟交的论文将不予接受。

senses.def: a small book of plain paper for writing notes in
a small book for students to write their work in
a small computer that can work with a battery and be easily carried
senses.chn: 笔记本式计算机；笔记本电脑

senses.def: a small folded card, sometimes with a picture on the front, that you use for writing a short letter on
senses.chn: （正面有图而折叠的）便笺卡，万用卡

senses.def: a card on which notes are written, for example by sb to use when making a speech
well known because of a special skill or feature

ex.en: a noted dancer
ex.cn: 著名的舞蹈演员

ex.en: He is not noted for his sense of humour.
ex.cn: 他没什么幽默感。

ex.en: The lake is noted as a home to many birds.
ex.cn: 这个湖作为许多鸟类的栖息地而闻名。

example.en: He is not noted for his sense of humour.
example.cn: 他没什么幽默感。

example.en: The lake is noted as a home to many birds.
example.cn: 这个湖作为许多鸟类的栖息地而闻名。

senses.def: a small folded sheet of paper or card with a picture on the front that you use for writing a short letter on
senses.chn: （正面有图而折叠的）便笺；短柬

senses.def: sheets of paper that are held together at the top and used for writing notes on

ex.en: a notepad by the phone for messages
ex.cn: 电话机旁用于记录信息的记事本

senses.def: paper for writing letters on
deserving to be noticed or to receive attention because it is unusual, important or interesting
senses.chn: 值得注意的；显著的；重要的

senses.def: used when you are saying the opposite of what you really mean
senses.chn: （说反话时用）根本不，决不，一点也不

ex.en: He wasn't exactly pleased to see us—in fact he refused to open the door.
ex.cn: 他根本不愿见我们，事实上他连门都不开。

ex.en: It's not exactly beautiful, is it?(= it's ugly)
ex.cn: 这一点也不美，是吗？

senses.def: used when you are correcting sth that sb has said
senses.chn: （纠正对方刚说过的话）不完全

ex.en: 'So he told you you'd got the job?' 'Not exactly, but he said they were impressed with me.'
ex.cn: “如此看来，他对你说你得到这份工作了？” “不完全是这样，不过他说我给他们留下了深刻的印象。”

senses.def: to not feel healthy and well
senses.chn: 觉得身体不好；感到身体不舒服

not for all the tea in china.lemma: not for all the tea in china

senses.def: not even for a great reward
senses.chn: 无论报酬多高都不；无论有多大好处都不

ex.en: I wouldn't do your job. Not for all the tea in China!
ex.cn: 我才不做你的那份工作。有天大的好处也不干！

senses.def: definitely not

ex.en: I wouldn't give it up for anything.
ex.cn: 我决不放弃。

senses.def: for a very good reason
senses.chn: 有充分理由；有正当理由

ex.en: Not for nothing was he called the king of rock and roll.
ex.cn: 他被称作摇滚之王不是没有道理的。

senses.def: without the aim of making a profit

ex.en: a not-for-profit organization
ex.cn: 非营利组织

senses.def: an organization that does not aim to make a profit
not suitable for people who lack confidence or who get frightened easily
senses.chn: 不适合缺乏信心的人；不适合胆怯之人

ex.en: The climb is not for the faint-hearted (= is only for people who are brave).
ex.cn: 攀岩绝不是胆小的人做的事。

senses.def: to not care at all about sth

not give sb the time of day.lemma: not give sb the time of day

senses.def: to refuse to speak to sb because you do not like or respect them

ex.en: Since the success of her novel, people shake her hand who once wouldn't have given her the time of day.
ex.cn: 自从她的小说获得成功之后，曾经懒得答理她的人也跟她握起手来。

senses.def: to not like sth and not want it in your house
senses.chn: 不喜欢把某物放在家里

senses.def: if you tell sb that a secret will go no further, you promise not to tell it to anyone else
to not be enough to buy a lot of things
senses.chn: 不够买，买不了（许多东西）

ex.en: Five pounds doesn't go very far these days.
ex.cn: 这年头五英镑买不了多少东西。

senses.def: to not be enough for what is needed

ex.en: Four bottles of wine won't go far among twenty people.
ex.cn: 四瓶酒不够二十人喝。

senses.def: used to emphasize a statement or an opinion

ex.en: It wasn't half good (= it was very good).
ex.cn: 这很好。

ex.en: 'Was she annoyed?' 'Not half!' (= she was extremely annoyed)
ex.cn: “她生气了吗？” “非常生气！”

senses.def: not nearly

ex.en: He is not half such a fool as they think.
ex.cn: 他远不是他们以为的那么傻。

senses.def: not bad at all; good

ex.en: It really isn't half bad, is it?
ex.cn: 这的确很不错，对吗？

senses.def: not nearly

ex.en: He is not half such a fool as they think.
ex.cn: 他远不是他们以为的那么傻。

not have a bar of sth.lemma: not have a bar of sth

senses.def: to have nothing to do with sth
senses.chn: 与（某事）无关；与（某事）毫不相干；不沾手

ex.en: If he tries to sell you his car, don't have a bar of it.
ex.cn: 他若是想要把车卖给你，你可别去理他。

senses.def: to have no money
to know nothing about sth or about how to do sth

ex.en: I don't have a clue where she lives.
ex.cn: 我完全不知道她住在哪里。

senses.def: to be very stupid

ex.en: Don't ask him to do it—he doesn't have a clue!
ex.cn: 这事别叫他做，他笨极了。

senses.def: to have no chance at all

ex.en: He hasn't a dog's chance of passing the exam.
ex.cn: 他根本不可能通过这次考试。

not have a hair out of place.lemma: not have a hair out of place

senses.def: to look extremely clean and neat

not have a leg to stand on.lemma: not have a leg to stand on

senses.def: to be in a position where you are unable to prove sth or explain why sth is reasonable
senses.chn: 无法证实；无法解释（理由）；站不住脚

ex.en: Without written evidence, we don't have a leg to stand on.
ex.cn: 我们没有书面证据就站不住脚。

senses.def: to not have much time

ex.en: Come on! We don't have all day!
ex.cn: 快一点！我们的时间不多了！

not have a snowball's chance in hell.lemma: not have a snowball's chance in hell

senses.def: to have no chance at all
to be naked
not willing to listen to or believe sth

ex.en: I tried to persuade her to wait but she wasn't having any.
ex.cn: 我竭力劝她等一下，可她不肯听。

senses.def: to refuse to let sb do sth, especially because you want to help them
senses.chn: 出于善意拒绝（或不允许）某事

ex.en: She wanted to walk home but I wouldn't hear of it.
ex.cn: 她想步行回家，但我就是不允许。

ex.en: He wouldn't hear of my walking home alone.
ex.cn: 他不让我独自一人走回家。

phrases.pattern: not hear of sb doing sth
phrases.filled: not hear of sb doing sth

example.en: He wouldn't hear of my walking home alone.
example.cn: 他不让我独自一人走回家。

senses.def: not anything; no single thing
senses.chn: 没有什么；没有一件东西

ex.en: There was nothing in her bag.
ex.cn: 她的包里什么都没有。

ex.en: There's nothing you can do to help.
ex.cn: 你什么忙也帮不上。

ex.en: The doctor said there was nothing wrong with me.
ex.cn: 医生说我什么毛病也没有。

ex.en: Nothing else matters to him apart from his job.
ex.cn: 对他来说，除了工作以外，什么事都无关紧要。

ex.en: It cost us nothing to go in.
ex.cn: 我们没花钱就进去了。

ex.en: He's five foot nothing (= exactly five feet tall).
ex.cn: 他正好五英尺高。

senses.def: something that is not at all important or interesting
senses.chn: 无关紧要的东西；毫无趣味的事

ex.en: 'What's that in your pocket?' 'Oh, nothing.'
ex.cn: “你口袋里装的是什么？” “哦，没什么重要的。”

ex.en: We did nothing at the weekend.
ex.cn: 我们周末什么也没干。

senses.def: to be a person for whom sb has no feelings
senses.chn: 对（某人）来说是无所谓的人

ex.en: I used to love her but she's nothing to me any more.
ex.cn: 我爱过她，但现在对她再也没什么感情了。

senses.def: to have no connection with sb/sth

ex.en: Get out! It's nothing to do with you (= you have no right to know about it).
ex.cn: 出去！这根本就不关你的事。

ex.en: That has nothing to do with what we're discussing.
ex.cn: 那与我们所讨论的问题毫不相干。

senses.def: without payment

ex.en: She's always trying to get something for nothing.
ex.cn: 她总想不劳而获。

senses.def: with no reward or result
senses.chn: 无酬劳；毫无结果；白白地

ex.en: All that preparation was for nothing because the visit was cancelled.
ex.cn: 访问被取消，所有的准备工作都白费了。

senses.def: to have much less of a particular quality than sb/sth
senses.chn: 远比不上某人；比某人差得多

ex.en: I'm quite a fast worker, but I've got nothing on her!
ex.cn: 我做事已经很麻利了，但比她还差得远。

senses.def: to have no information that could show sb to be guilty of sth
for a very good reason
senses.chn: 有充分理由；有正当理由

ex.en: Not for nothing was he called the king of rock and roll.
ex.cn: 他被称作摇滚之王不是没有道理的。

senses.def: only; no more/less than

ex.en: Nothing but a miracle can save her now.
ex.cn: 现在只有出现奇迹才能救活她。

ex.en: I want nothing but the best for my children.
ex.cn: 我只想给我的孩子最好的一切。

senses.def: extremely; very

ex.en: The trip was nothing if not varied.
ex.cn: 这次旅行极其丰富多彩。

senses.def: used to emphasize how great or extreme sth is

ex.en: It was nothing less than a disaster.
ex.cn: 这简直就是一场灾难。

senses.def: not at all like

ex.en: It looks nothing like a horse.
ex.cn: 它看上去根本不像一匹马。

senses.def: not nearly; not at all

ex.en: I had nothing like enough time to answer all the questions.
ex.cn: 我根本来不及回答所有的问题。

senses.def: not a great amount of sth; nothing of great value or importance
senses.chn: 不很多；不太重要；价值不太大

ex.en: There's nothing much in the fridge.
ex.cn: 冰箱里没什么东西了。

ex.en: I got up late and did nothing much all day.
ex.cn: 我起来晚了，一天没怎么做事。

senses.def: (it's) very easy
